description.value: Rice & Noodle is a casual counter-service Asian kitchen specializing in pad thai and customizable rice and noodle dishes, operating as a franchise chain. Diners choose from 13 dishes, then select protein (chicken, beef, prawn, tofu, or mixed veggies) and spice level up to 'extreme.' The relaxed, fast-casual format is well suited to a quick refuel stop on Kingsway.

bike_parking_detail: 6 racks within 100m: stands at 52m; stands at 62m; stands (3 spaces) at 68m; stands at 68m; stands (3 spaces) at 70m; stands (3 spaces) at 98m. Total: 9 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active Thai/Asian quick-service restaurant chain with online ordering, matching the OSM record. Menu explicitly lists tofu and mixed veggie protein options confirming vegetarian availability, and the prominent 'ORDER NOW' call-to-action confirms takeout. Neither the website content nor OSM tags mention bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities.
concerns: OSM name uses '&' while the website logo uses '+' (RICE + NOODLE); this is a minor stylistic difference, not a substantive mismatch.
Website navigation includes 'Locations' and 'Franchise' links indicating a multi-location chain; the specific Unit 202 address was not independently confirmed on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible restaurant with a confirmed working website and online ordering. A practical quick-service meal stop for cyclists on Kingsway.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Tofu and Mixed Veggies listed as explicit protein options across all dishes; vegetarian spring rolls offered as a side
